description: This file 'numbers.h' contains function declarations and internal implementations for converting strings to numbers, including integer, floating-point, and hexadecimal conversions, as well as related utility functions within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: absl::numbers_internal
classes.description: Namespace containing internal helper functions and constants for number conversions.

methods.name: absl::SimpleAtoi
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer of specified type, supporting different bases.

methods.name: absl::SimpleAtof
methods.description: Converts a string to a float.

methods.name: absl::SimpleAtod
methods.description: Converts a string to a double.

methods.name: absl::SimpleAtob
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean.

methods.name: absl::SimpleHexAtoi
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to an integer of specified type.
